title: dichanthelium patentifolium
intro: Dichanthelium patentifolium, commonly known as Ohio bent or patent bent grass, is a perennial grass species belonging to the Poaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Dichanthelium patentifolium include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
